title: Lower Power: Squat
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Tri-Planar Ankle × 8/side · Inchworm Walk × 4 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side · A-skip 2 × 20 yd · B-skip 2 × 20 yd
jumps: Back Squat 1 @ RPE 7.5 (~90%) → Box Jump 4 → DB Jump Squat 4 → Pogo Hops 8
Rest 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · heavy single, then fast
note: Last power week: heaviest single of the block, much less volume. Every rep fast.
